description: Published MSES code-to-code comparison: NLR7301 2.6% gap, ICAS2006 paper512 Figure6 p6. Re2.51e6 M0.185. CL only. Ncrit9 assumed; original Ncrit, trips, mesh, exact coordinates and convergence settings not disclosed. Nominal ECARP geometry; no fit.

benchmark.scope: CL(alpha), sampled lift peak; no MSES CD/CM/Cp/transition reference scored
notes: Comparison to digitized published MSES results; MSES has not been run here.
Shared nominal Re, Mach and configuration; exact input-deck reproduction is not possible from the paper.
MSES version, Ncrit, trips, mesh, geometry file and residual tolerance are not specified. The cited 2.92 manual does not establish the executable version.
Ncrit9 and nominal ECARP coordinates are explicit MultiFoil assumptions; no settings fitted to match MSES.
CL reading allowance +/-0.015; incidence reading allowance +/-0.10 degree. These are digitization allowances, not MSES uncertainty.
Agreement with MSES is not independent experimental validation.
